question: Who is the author of the famous Kannada play ‘Tughlaq’ which is also staged in other Indian languages?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Girish Karnad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Girish Karnad** was an Indian actor, film director, Kannada writer, playwright, and a Rhodes Scholar.
 
• He wrote the play **'Tughlaq'** in 1964, which was a critical and commercial success.
 
• The play is based on the life of **Muhammad bin Tughlaq**, a 14th-century Sultan of Delhi.
 
• 'Tughlaq' has been translated into several Indian languages and is considered one of the best works in Indian theatre.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Girish Karnad:**

 
 
• Born on May 19, 1938, in Matheran, Maharashtra, Girish Karnad was a renowned figure in Indian theatre and cinema.
 
• He was awarded the Jnanpith Award, India's highest literary honor, in 1998 for his contributions to literature.
 
• Karnad's works often explore contemporary issues through historical and mythological themes.
 
• In addition to 'Tughlaq', some of his other notable plays include 'Yayati', 'Hayavadana', and 'Nagamandala'.
 
 
 
• **Muhammad bin Tughlaq:**
 
 
• Muhammad bin Tughlaq was the Sultan of Delhi from 1325 to 1351.
 
• He is known for his ambitious and often controversial policies, including the transfer of the capital from Delhi to Daulatabad and the introduction of token currency.
 
• His reign was marked by both innovative ideas and harsh measures, which have been subjects of extensive historical debate.
 
• Girish Karnad's play 'Tughlaq' delves into the complexities of Tughlaq's character and his tumultuous rule.
 
 
 
• **Kannada Literature:**
 
 
• Kannada literature has a rich history dating back over a thousand years.
 
• It includes works of poetry, fiction, drama, and philosophical writings by various renowned authors and poets.
 
• Some of the notable figures in Kannada literature include Kuvempu, Masti Venkatesha Iyengar, and Chandrashekhara Kambara.
 
• Kannada literature has made significant contributions to Indian culture and continues to be a vibrant and evolving field.
